# Guidebook Framework – 3 New Docs Plans (DO NOT edit original proposal/form)

## Constraints (from user)
- Target: Asia University first-year students (~50, target 40 valid + 25 feedback), English main, VN students + small teacher part
- Originals locked: DRAFT PROJECT PROPOSAL GROUP 1 + VN survey form – NO edits, only new docs
- Docs-only build, textbook-like: separated chapters, reason + graph + picture per chapter, routines before theory
- RQs revised: RQ1 benefits, RQ2 barriers, RQ3 most influential factors for Asia first-years in online/digital self-study (LMS/recorded/videos/meetings/platforms)
- Each rec must link to survey Top 3-5 finding, not pre-chosen. Advice = group-curated research + survey, teacher facilitates (answers teacher comment on expertise)
- Ethics: voluntary anonymous, NO names/IDs, aggregated, permission for channels
- Timeline: Wk1 Research/Planning/Preparation, Wk2 Implementation/Evaluation. Descriptive stats only.

## Research map
- G1 Self-regulation & time: Zimmerman cycle, SMART, ALPEN, Pomodoro, Retrieval Roediger 2006, Dunlosky 2013, OSLQ
- G2 Distraction & concentration: Brain Drain Ward 2017, Ophir/Nass/Wagner 2009, Uncapher 2018, Attention Residue, CLT Sweller extraneous
- G3 Interaction & support: CoI Garrison (teaching/social/cognitive), Moore transactional distance, Martin & Bolliger 2018, peer feedback/help-seeking
- G4 Fatigue & tech: Bailenson Zoom overload, Technostress Saleem 2024, Jordan 2026 extrinsic-load ceiling, Huberman light/sleep/focus, 20-20-20, segmenting

---
## DOC 1 – Practical Short (6-8p, student, routines first)
1. Cover: Online Learning Effectiveness Guide for Our Class – Asia University First-Years
2. How to use: pick top difficulty -> go to chapter, 5-min routine first
3. Ch1 Self-regulation & time: SMART tonight + ALPEN tomorrow + 25-5x2. [Graph: Week1 current-use %] [Picture: desk timer + checklist]
4. Ch2 Distraction: phone in drawer + 1-tab + notifications off. Why 3 lines: Brain Drain, multitasking. [Picture: phone-out vs on-desk]
5. Ch3 Interaction: question template + peer check + help post. [Picture: chat example]
6. Ch4 Fatigue & tech: 50-10, 20-20-20, pre-check net/mic. Why: Bailenson, technostress. [Picture: stretch + screen distance]
7. One-page Class Guide table: Finding -> Do this (Top 3-5 only)
8. Feedback QR + 3Qs clarity/relevance/use (target 25). Teacher footer box only.

## DOC 2 – Detailed Long (20+p, evidence)
1. Title + Goal + SMART (40 Wk1, rank 3-5 Wk1, guide+25 Wk2)
2. Context: online/digital self-study, Broadbent & Poon 2015, Martin & Bolliger 2018
3. RQs revised (see above)
4. Methods: anonymous Forms 10-12Q (MC + 5-Likert + 2 open), %/avg/rank, n~50 target 40, voluntary
5. Results placeholders: [Graph1 current use] [Graph2 barrier ranking 4 dims] [Graph3 Likert benefits] [Table open themes]
6. Ch1-4 Deep each: Finding ID -> Theory -> Practice (theories per Research map)
7. Discussion: each rec linked to finding, Limitations, Refs, Appendix survey + Action Table + distribution log

## DOC 3 – Mix Textbook (teacher-use, 12-15p)
1. Lesson plan 15-min: objectives, materials (Doc1 print/Forms/Sheets/Canva)
2. Lesson 1-4 each 2p: Student routine (Doc1) + Reason box (1 para) + Teacher script 2min + Activity 5min + Mistake to correct + [Graph: class bar] [Picture demo]
3. Norms: lecturer/rep permission, 5-7min survey, 2 reminders, test link + backup
4. Closing + feedback collection (indicators: 40/25, share proof)

## Build order
Doc1 routine tables first (needed Week1), then Doc3 lessons, then Doc2 evidence fill after survey results.
